description.content: Real-time type-ahead geocoding for user input

Returns real-time geocoding suggestions as the user types. Best used with client-side throttling (5–10 requests per second). Results include GeoJSON features ranked by relevance and optional geographic focus.

query.description: (Required) Free-form text to geocode (addresses, place names, etc.)
Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 40)
BCP47 language tag for preferred response language (e.g. en, fr, de). Not all places have translated names.
Latitude of the focus point to boost nearby results
Longitude of the focus point to boost nearby results
Minimum longitude of rectangular boundary (western edge)
Maximum longitude of rectangular boundary (eastern edge)
Minimum latitude of rectangular boundary (southern edge)
Maximum latitude of rectangular boundary (northern edge)
Latitude of the center of a circular boundary
Longitude of the center of a circular boundary
Radius in km of the circular boundary
Comma-separated list of ISO-3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country codes to restrict results
Pelias gid of an administrative area to restrict results within
Comma-separated list of data sources to query. Valid values: openstreetmap (osm), openaddresses (oa), whosonfirst (wof), geonames (gn)

Comma-separated list of layer types to restrict results. Valid values: venue, address, street, neighbourhood, borough, localadmin, locality, county, macrocounty, region, macroregion, country, coarse, postalcode

description.content:
Pelias is a modular, open-source geocoding search engine built on Elasticsearch. It converts addresses and place names into geographic coordinates (forward geocoding) and geographic coordinates into places and addresses (reverse geocoding). Powered entirely by open data from OpenStreetMap, OpenAddresses, Who's on First, and Geonames, it is freely available under the MIT license and can be self-hosted or accessed via hosted services such as geocode.earth.
